title: HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB (UK)
tickerText:
WELCOME TO HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB, WHERE BIG LAUGHS, BRILLIANT COMEDIANS AND UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS OF LIVE ENTERTAINMENT TAKE CENTRE STAGE!

OUR FLAGSHIP COMEDY SHOWS BRING TOGETHER SOME OF THE UK'S FINEST STAND-UP TALENT, FEATURING EXCEPTIONAL HEADLINE COMEDIANS, FAMILIAR FACES FROM YOUR FAVOURITE TELEVISION SHOWS AND EXCITING PERFORMERS FROM ACROSS THE INTERNATIONAL COMEDY CIRCUIT.

EXPECT RAZOR-SHARP WIT, HILARIOUS STORIES, OUTRAGEOUS OBSERVATIONS, LIGHTNING-FAST PUNCHLINES AND THE ELECTRIC ATMOSPHERE THAT ONLY LIVE STAND-UP COMEDY CAN DELIVER.

WHETHER YOU'RE A DEDICATED COMEDY FAN OR SIMPLY LOOKING FOR A FANTASTIC NIGHT OUT WITH FRIENDS, HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB SERVES UP A BRILLIANT MIX OF ESTABLISHED STARS AND EXCITING COMEDIC TALENT.

FROM SIDE-SPLITTING LAUGHTER TO UNEXPECTED MOMENTS OF COMEDY GOLD, EVERY SHOW PROMISES AN ENTERTAINING EXPERIENCE YOU WON'T SOON FORGET.

HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB – BIG NAMES, BIG PERSONALITIES AND EVEN BIGGER LAUGHS!

channelMasterConfig.tickerText: WELCOME TO HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB, WHERE BIG LAUGHS, BRILLIANT COMEDIANS AND UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS OF LIVE ENTERTAINMENT TAKE CENTRE STAGE! • OUR FLAGSHIP COMEDY SHOWS BRING TOGETHER SOME OF THE UK'S FINEST STAND-UP TALENT, FEATURING EXCEPTIONAL HEADLINE COMEDIANS, FAMILIAR FACES FROM YOUR FAVOURITE TELEVISION SHOWS AND EXCITING PERFORMERS FROM ACROSS THE INTERNATIONAL COMEDY CIRCUIT. • EXPECT RAZOR-SHARP WIT, HILARIOUS STORIES, OUTRAGEOUS OBSERVATIONS, LIGHTNING-FAST PUNCHLINES AND THE ELECTRIC ATMOSPHERE THAT ONLY LIVE STAND-UP COMEDY CAN DELIVER. • WHETHER YOU'RE A DEDICATED COMEDY FAN OR SIMPLY LOOKING FOR A FANTASTIC NIGHT OUT WITH FRIENDS, HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB SERVES UP A BRILLIANT MIX OF ESTABLISHED STARS AND EXCITING COMEDIC TALENT. • FROM SIDE-SPLITTING LAUGHTER TO UNEXPECTED MOMENTS OF COMEDY GOLD, EVERY SHOW PROMISES AN ENTERTAINING EXPERIENCE YOU WON'T SOON FORGET. • HOT WATER COMEDY CLUB – BIG NAMES, BIG PERSONALITIES AND EVEN BIGGER LAUGHS!
